subject: Joint Eval Blueprint — Week0 ops + MAP seed (NovaHealth)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Joint Eval Blueprint — Week0 ops + MAP seed (NovaHealth)

Hi Alex,

Nice to meet you — thanks for taking the call yesterday. As promised, I drafted a compact "Week0" blueprint and a MAP seed to get NovaHealth into a short pilot. The goals: validate latency/cost on your sample dataset, confirm SSO & data controls, and measure end-to-end acceptance criteria in 30 days.

Draft assets (editable):
- NR-Blueprint-week0.gdoc (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-NR-blueprint
- MAP-stub-slides.pptx (attached): quick stakeholder lanes and acceptance gates

Short proposed timeline (high-level):
1) Week0 (prep, security + SSO config, sample data ingest) — owner: NovaHealth + Redwood infra
2) Week1 (pilot validation, perf measurements, integration smoke tests) — owner: joint
3) Weeks 2–4 (iteration, user acceptance, acceptance gate review) — decision at day 30

Immediate asks:
- Can you confirm the procurement contact and legal review timeline?
- Who will be the technical lead on your side for SSO and sample data access?
- Any mandatory compliance docs we should prep now (SOC2, DPA templates, etc.)?

I copied Marissa (solutions architect) to own runbook and Jordan (CS lead) to help frame acceptance metrics. I can update the doc with your SSO checklist if you send the requirements.

Attachments: MAP-stub-slides.pptx

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a short SOW template for procurement once we land stakeholders.

—
Chloe Martin
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai

Thanks Chloe — this looks like a good starting point. A few quick notes from our side:
- Procurement: procurement@novahealth.com (looping them here). They typically need a short SOW + pricing sheet; can you send a one-page SOW we can attach?
- Security: we require an initial SSO requirements doc and a list of any shared logs you collect. I work with Emma White (security) on this — I’ll introduce her if necessary.
- Timeline: week0 prep is fine, but our infra team prefers an internal window to review before we hand off SSO creds. Can you include a one-day buffer between Week0 and Week1 for infra sign-off?

Availability for a short demo: Thu 9/18 between 10–11am PT or Fri 9/19 afternoon.

I’ll review the doc this afternoon and flag any internal questions.

- Added SSO checklist section (SSO: SAML/SCIM, attribute map, test user)
- Added security docs checklist (we’ve attached a short SOW template for procurement)
- Week0 runbook owners: Marissa (Redwood infra steps), NovaHealth infra (ingest + test creds)

Editable links:
- NR-Blueprint-week0.gdoc (updated): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-NR-blueprint
- SOW-template.pdf (attached)

Proposed updated timeline:
- Week0: prep + security (3 business days)
- Gap day: infra sign-off (1 business day)
- Week1: pilot validation (5 business days)
- Days 10–30: iterate -> acceptance gate at day 30

Marissa — can you confirm the runbook checklist below and add any infra pre-reqs?
Marissa, quick ask: can you prepare a 1-page "Week0 ops runbook" by EOD Wednesday? That will help procurement and infra expedite.

Thanks — I’ll lock the demo for Thu 9/18 10:30am PT if that works for you, Alex.

Chloe / Alex —

I’ve sketched the Week0 ops runbook and uploaded a short checklist into the shared drive doc (see NR-Blueprint-week0.gdoc). Key infra pre-reqs:
- Test SAML app with one sandbox user (SCIM optional, recommended)
- Sample dataset (anonymized) uploaded to S3/GCS with read keys for Redwood agent
- Network: allow outbound 443 to redwood-serving-us.redwood.ai IP range (we’ll send exact CIDR)
- Logging: enable request logs and share retention expectations (we don’t store PII by default)

I’ll attach the runbook as a one-pager to the doc by EOD. Jordan — I left two acceptance metrics placeholders (latency p95, tokens/call cost) — can you fill if you want different targets?

—
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
